checks.name: step1_domain_target_matches_c141_f7_solution
checks.detail: got (domain,target)=(2,1), expected (2,1) -- C141's own F7 exhaustive search (script line ~318) found (mult_1,mult_3,mult_3bar)=(0,1,2) is one of exactly two module types giving shape (2,1); this re-derives it via the identical trivial_mult() function, not a new formula.

checks.name: step2_wcand_su3_action_block_diagonal
checks.detail: W_cand's 9x9 su(3) action has exactly zero cross-blocks between m (rows/cols 0-5) and 3bar_extra (rows/cols 6-8) for all 8 generators -- confirms 3bar_extra is genuinely decoupled from m, per C139 Section 17's own 'no NOMIZU-derived data for an extra summand, only buildable as decoupled' reasoning (there quoted for m(+)2*1's extra singlets; applied here to W_cand's extra 3bar summand, one assumption transferred by direct analogy, not re-derived from new geometric content -- see decision.md's self-adversarial pass for why this transfer is checked, not merely assumed).

checks.name: step4_load_bearing_no_singlet_in_sigma_even_tensor_3bar_extra
checks.detail: got 0 su(3)-invariant vectors in Sigma_even (x) 3bar_extra (12-dim ambient) -- the load-bearing claim: no su(3)-invariant target vector exists for a decoupled 3bar_extra connection to map into, forcing its own contribution to target_inv to be zero REGARDLESS of what connection it carries.

checks.name: step4_sigma_odd_tensor_3bar_extra_has_exactly_one_singlet
checks.detail: got 1 su(3)-invariant vectors in Sigma_odd (x) 3bar_extra (12-dim ambient) -- consistent with Step 1's domain=2: one dimension from m's own 3bar (already C139-certified), one from 3bar_extra's own singlet channel (3 (x) 3bar_extra -> 1).

checks.name: step4_cross_validation_trivial_mult_matches_explicit_nullspace
checks.detail: abstract branching-count method (trivial_mult) gives (0,1); explicit su(3)-invariant-subspace computation gives (0,1) -- two independent methods must agree, and do.

checks.name: step3_target_inv_avoids_3bar_extras_own_block
checks.detail: target_inv's basis vector has exactly zero components in 3bar_extra's own 3-dim W-slot -- confirms Step 3: target_inv is entirely m's own channel.

checks.name: domain_on_splits_cleanly_into_m_channel_and_extra_channel
checks.detail: the 2 domain_inv basis vectors should decouple into one purely-m-block vector and one purely-extra-block vector, since W_cand's su(3) action and connection are both block-diagonal (Step 2) -- checked directly, not assumed.

checks.name: step5_d_extra_is_zero_at_the_natural_zero_connection
checks.detail: got d_extra=0 at the natural (decoupled, zero-connection) instantiation -- expected exactly 0.

checks.name: step5_d_m_matches_c139s_own_certified_c_magnitude
checks.detail: |d_m|=1.1547005383792515, |C139.c_exact|=1.1547005383792515 -- must match (up to the already-documented gauge phase freedom, C139 Section 6): target_inv here is literally the same 1-dim invariant C139 already certified.

checks.name: step4b_d_extra_vanishes_identically_for_arbitrary_nonzero_connection
checks.detail: d_extra(t)=0 -- must be IDENTICALLY zero as a function of t (not merely at t=0) to support claim.md's 'regardless of what connection' clause. Scope caveat (see decision.md): this uses ONE fixed antisymmetric 3x3 shape scaled by a single symbol t (uniform across i=1..6), not the FULL space of possible decoupled connections -- a genuine, honestly-scoped limitation, not a claim of full generality.

checks.name: step4b_d_m_is_independent_of_3bar_extras_own_connection_t
checks.detail: d_m(t)=-2*sqrt(3)/3, d(d_m)/dt=0 -- m's own channel must not depend on 3bar_extra's connection at all, confirming the block-diagonal decoupling holds all the way through the Dirac operator, not just the su(3) action.

checks.name: step6_rank_is_exactly_1
checks.detail: got rank=1, expected 1 (d_m!=0, d_extra=0, so a 1x2 nonzero row has rank 1)

checks.name: step6_delta_dyn_is_forced_zero
